behavior.explicit_summary_disabled: Do not enqueue the independent spreadsheet-summary task on upload, file-URL import, or either reparse path.
behavior.default: Preserve upstream behavior when the override or summary_enabled is omitted, or true.
behavior.scope: This patch controls table-summary enqueue only; all other LLM enhancements require their separate documented opt-outs.
behavior.ui_upload_reparse: BLOCKED: this explicit opt-out patch does not enforce an instance-wide zero-generation profile, and the unmodified UI defaults document summaries to enabled.
